accordion.description: Collapsible content panels for saving vertical space.

accordion.item.description: An individual collapsible item within an accordion.

alert.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

alert-dialog.description: Modal dialog specifically designed for alerting users to important information or actions.

aspect.description: A container component to maintain consistent proportions for media and content.

audio.description: A styled wrapper for HTML5 audio content.

avatar.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

badge.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

breadcrumb.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

breadcrumb.item.description: Individual item in a breadcrumb trail.

button.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

button.loader.description: Button with built-in loading state management.

button.toggle.description: Button that toggles between two states.

calendar.description: A visual calendar interface for selecting dates.

card.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

carousel.description: A slideshow component for cycling through elements.

carousel.item.description: An individual slide within a carousel.

chart.description: Basic chart component for data visualization (bar, line).

code.description: A component for displaying code snippets with a copy-to-clipboard feature.

command.description: A powerful search and action interface accessible via keyboard shortcuts.

command.group.description: Groups related items in a command palette.

command.item.description: An actionable item within a command palette.

data-table.description: Advanced table with sorting, filtering, and pagination. Powered by AlpineJS. Supports client-side data or server-side fetching via URL.

divider.description: Visually separates content sections with an optional label.

drawer.description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.

dropdown.description: Displays a menu to the user—such as a set of actions or functions—triggered by a button.

dropdown.item.description: An actionable item within a dropdown menu.

empty-state.description: Use this component to show a placeholder when a list or page has no data.

figure.description: Enhanced image component with captions, aspect ratio control, and support for modern image formats.

form.description: A collection of form components for user input.

form.checkbox.description: A checkbox input for boolean selection.

form.datetime.description: A date and time picker input.

form.element.description: Base wrapper for form inputs, handling labels and errors.

form.file.description: A file upload input with drag-and-drop support.

form.input.description: Standard text input fields, including password and number variants.

form.label.description: A label for a form input.

form.radio.description: A radio button for single selection.

form.range.description: A slider input for selecting a value within a range.

form.section.description: A titled section for organizing form fields.

form.toggle.description: A toggle switch for boolean selection.

gallery.description: Responsive grid layout for images and figures.

icon.description: Displays an icon from the Iconify library.

modal.description: A dialog box or popup window that is displayed on top of the current page.

navbar.description: A top-level navigation component for site-wide links and actions.

navbar.mobile-item.description: Individual navigation link for mobile menu.

navbar.mobile-toggle.description: Toggle button for the mobile menu.

pagination.description: Displays a sequence of links for navigating through a series of related pages. Powered by AlpineJS.

popover.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

progress.description: A bar that shows the completion progress of a task.

search.description: Styled search input with an integrated results dropdown.

search.result.description: An individual result item within a search component.

skeleton.description: A placeholder for content that is loading.

spacer.description: A utility component that fills available space in a flex container.

stepper.actions.description: Standard actions layout for stepper components.

stepper.step.description: An individual step within a stepper component.

tabs.description: A set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that are displayed one at a time.

tabs.panel.description: Content panel for a specific tab.

toaster.description: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

tooltip.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

video.description: A styled wrapper for HTML5 video, YouTube, and Vimeo content.
